what: mutation checks of the golden parity (PLAN 8.4): cbst, cycle_count, hyper_sssp, hypergraph, kit, label_propagation, mosp, sssp, triad_count, triad_reference

goldens.sssp: sssp (MOSP-OpenMP@c352151; the mosp outputs included), parity/goldens.toml
goldens.cbst: the committed CBST traces (cpp/tests/data/goldens/cbst_trace) and the lockstep and graph-on-CBST tests (no golden corpus)
goldens.hyper_sssp: hyper_sssp's and the slack_csr container's tests: the committed subset of hyper_sssp_mosp_escher (cpp/tests/data/goldens/hyper_sssp) by id, the oracle dyng::testing::hyper_sssp_reference / line_graph_delta, the CBST traces
goldens.hypergraph: the committed traces and batch extracts (cpp/tests/data/goldens/{cbst_trace,hypergraph_batches}) and the container's lockstep tests
goldens.triad_count: triad_count's tests against the independent oracle (dyng::testing::triad_reference) on every backend (no golden corpus)
goldens.label_propagation: label_propagation's tests against the independent oracles (dyng::testing::harmonic_solution, union_find, lp_host_model) and the original's damped counts and hub golden, on sequential and cuda

build: parity-cuda preset, targets dyng-compat-mosp / dyng-compat-cycle-enum / the cbst test executables, from git archive HEAD
